logicalViews.customSQLV2: SELECT "Temp"."CustomDateTimeSQL", "Temp"."CustomDateTimeSQL"::DATE AS "CustomDateSQL" FROM (SELECT GENERATE_SERIES(CAST('1970-01-01T:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST('2027-12-31T:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMPTZ), interval '1' day) AS "CustomDateTimeSQL") "Temp"

semanticDimensions.description: Date only (without time)
semanticDimensions.label: Date

semanticDimensions.description: Full datetime (with time)
semanticDimensions.label: Date Time

calcs.description: (Forecasting field) Sets the start date of the forecast period to 1 month or quarter before today.
calcs.expression: DATE(     IF [Business_Period].[Is_Forecast_Period] = TRUE THEN              IF [Business_Period].[Fully_Qualified_Name] =             "FQ" + STR(DATEPART('quarter', DATEADD('quarter', -1, TODAY()))) +             " FY " + STR(DATEPART('year', DATEADD('quarter', -1, TODAY())))         THEN             [Business_Period].[Start_Date]            ELSEIF [Business_Period].[Fully_Qualified_Name] =             UPPER(LEFT(DATENAME('month', DATEADD('month', -1, TODAY())), 1)) +             LOWER(MID(DATENAME('month', DATEADD('month', -1, TODAY())), 2)) +             " FY " + STR(DATEPART('year', DATEADD('month', -1, TODAY())))         THEN             [Business_Period].[Start_Date]         END     END )
calcs.label: Start Date( One Period Ago) Forecasting Field
Account Amount Per user in Previous Quarter

calcs.description: Returns the previous total sale amount for the opportunity.
calcs.expression: IFNULL({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : MAX(IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]:      MAX(         IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]: MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) }         THEN DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])         END     ) } THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount] END)},0)
calcs.label: Total Sales

calcs.description: (Forecasting field) Sets the end date of the forecast period
calcs.expression: IF [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Effective_To_Date] >= NOW() THEN NOW() ELSE [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Effective_To_Date] END
calcs.label: End Date Forecasting

calcs.description: (Forecasting field) Sets the start date of the forecast period
calcs.label: Start Date Forecasting
Average Days in Stage (per Opportunity) Forecasting

calcs.description: Average opportunity length. Calculated as the sum of CloseDate minus CreatedDate for all Closed Won Opportunities divided by the total number of Closed Won Opportunities.
calcs.expression: AVG(IF UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed]) = 'TRUE' AND UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Won]) = 'TRUE'     THEN (DATEDIFF('day',[Opportunity].[Created_Date], [Opportunity].[Close_Date]))  END)
calcs.label: Average Days to Close

calcs.description: The sum of Total Amount for all Closed Won Opportunities
calcs.label: Bookings

calcs.description: The total amount of all Closed Won Opportunities divided by the total number of Closed Won Opportunities.
calcs.label: Average Deal Size

calcs.expression: IF MIN([Business_Period].[Start_Date]) = MIN([Start_Date_One_Period_Ago_RI_clc]) THEN AVG([Average_Deal_Size_clc]) ELSE 0 END
calcs.label: Average Deal Size (Previous Quarter)

calcs.description: Calculates the average booking amount.
calcs.label: Average Booking Amount

calcs.expression: (   [Average_Days_to_Close_RI_clc] -    AVG({ FIXED [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Opportunity] :        AVG(IF [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date] >= DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY())        AND UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed]) = 'TRUE'        AND UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Won]) = 'TRUE'        THEN DATEDIFF('day', [Opportunity].[Created_Date], [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[New_Close_Date])        END)   }) )  / [Average_Days_to_Close_RI_clc]
calcs.label: Average days to close 7 days comparision

calcs.description: Returns the earliest created date for the opportunity.
calcs.label: Earliest Created Date

calcs.description: Checks if the opportunity history's created date is the minimum (earliest) for that opportunity.
calcs.label: Minimum Creation Date

calcs.description: Returns the latest created date for the opportunity, or a future date if none exists.
calcs.label: Created Date

calcs.description: Calculates the number of days between the minimum and maximum valid dates for a stage, or between the minimum and now if still open.
calcs.expression: IF [Valid_to_With_MAX_RI_clc]  >= NOW() THEN     DATEDIFF('day', [Valid_FromWith_MIN_RI_clc], NOW()) ELSE     DATEDIFF('day',[Valid_FromWith_MIN_RI_clc], [Valid_to_With_MAX_RI_clc]) END
calcs.label: Stage Dates

calcs.description: Calculates the average number of days the opportunity has been in the all stage.
calcs.label: Avg Days in Stage

calcs.expression: MAX({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity],[Opportunity_History].[Created_Date] : SUM( 	    IF [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] IN ("BestCase")          AND DATE([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY()) 	    THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)})
calcs.label: Best Case Forecast in Last 7 Days

calcs.description: Count of best case opportunities. Calculated as total amount of all Open Opportunities where the Forecast Category is equal to Best Case.
calcs.expression: MAX({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity],[Opportunity_History].[Created_Date] : SUM( 	    IF [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] IN ("BestCase")  	    THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)})
calcs.label: Best Case Opportunities

calcs.description: Total number of opportunities (won and lost).
calcs.label: Closed Opportunities

calcs.description: Total closed won opportunities. Calculated as sum of Opportunity Total Amount where Forecast Category is Closed.
calcs.expression: SUM( 	    IF [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Forecast_Category1] IN ("Closed")  	    THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)
calcs.label: Closed Won Opportunities

calcs.description: The total number of Closed Won Opportunities
calcs.label: Closed Won Opportunities

calcs.description: Total amount of all closed won opportunities.
calcs.expression: SUM( 	    IF UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed]) = 'TRUE' AND UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Won]) = 'TRUE' 	    THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)
calcs.label: Closed Won Sales RI

calcs.expression: (AVG( 	    IF [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Forecast_Category1] IN ("Closed")  	    THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)     - ZN(AVG(     IF [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date] <= DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY())     AND[Opportunity].[Opportunity_Forecast_Category1] = "Closed"     THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount]     END   )) )/AVG( 	    IF [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Forecast_Category1] IN ("Closed")  	    THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)
calcs.label: Closed won Opportunities 7 days Comparision

calcs.description: Total commit opportunities. Calculated as sum of Opportunity Total Amount where Forecast Category is Forecast and Closed.
calcs.expression: MAX({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity],[Opportunity_History].[Created_Date] : SUM( 	    IF [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] IN ("Forecast", "Closed")  	    THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount] 	    ELSE 0  	    END 	)})
calcs.label: Commit Opportunities Forecasting Field

calcs.description: Number of opportunities with a total activity count flag.
calcs.label: Count Flag

calcs.description: Top open opportunities by amount for the selected period.
calcs.expression: IF MIN(UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed])) = 'FALSE' AND MAX(DATEDIFF('day',[Opportunity].[Last_Modified_Date],NOW()))>60 THEN COUNT([Opportunity].[Opportunity_Id]) END
calcs.label: Neglected Opportunities Count

calcs.expression: { MAX(     IF YEAR(TODAY()) = YEAR([Opportunity_History].[Close_Date])     THEN DATEDIFF(         'day',         TODAY(),         DATETRUNC('quarter', DATEADD('quarter', 1, TODAY())) - 1     )     END ) }
calcs.label: Days Remaining

calcs.description: Opportunity Last Touched date
calcs.label: Days Since last Activity

calcs.expression: SUM(   IF DATETRUNC('quarter', [Opportunity].[Last_Activity_Date])       = DATEADD('quarter', -1, DATETRUNC('quarter', TODAY()))   THEN 1 END )
calcs.label: Days Since last activity in Previous Quarter

calcs.description: Calculates the number of days from now until the opportunity's close date.
calcs.label: Days To Close

calcs.description: Calculates the number of days the opportunity has been in the current stage.
calcs.label: Days in Stage

calcs.expression: IF [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] <= 10 THEN "1. 0-10 Days" ELSEIF [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] > 10 AND [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] <= 20 THEN "2. 11-20 Days" ELSEIF [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] > 20 AND [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] <= 30 THEN "3. 21-30 Days" ELSEIF [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] > 30 AND [Days_per_Stage_Segment_Forecasting_RI_clc] <= 40 THEN "4. 31-40 Days" ELSE "5. 41+ Days" END
calcs.label: Days per Stage Bucketing

calcs.description: Returns the close date for the opportunity history record with the latest created date.
calcs.label: Latest Created Date

calcs.description: Returns the latest close date for the opportunity, using the calculated latest close date field.
calcs.label: Latest Close Date

calcs.description: Close date. Returns the Close Date from the previous Opportunity History record for the same opportunity.
calcs.expression: IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]:      MAX(         IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]: MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) }         THEN DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])         END     ) } THEN  DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Close_Date]) END
calcs.label: Previous Close Date

calcs.description: Returns the previous close date for the opportunity, using the calculated previous close date field.
calcs.label: Previous Opportunity Close Date

calcs.description: Calculates the difference in days between the previous and latest close dates.
calcs.label: Close Date Difference

calcs.description: Calculates the difference between the current and previous total sale amounts.
calcs.label: Total Sales Difference

calcs.expression: MAX({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity],[Opportunity_History].[Created_Date] : SUM(     IF [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] IN ("Pipeline","Best Case", "Most Likely", "Commit")      AND DATE([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY())     THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount]     ELSE 0     END )})
calcs.label: Open Pipeline in last 7 days Opportunity

calcs.description: Calculates the sum of total sale amounts for opportunities in certain forecast categories (Pipeline, Best Case, Most Likely, Commit).
calcs.expression: MAX({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity],[Opportunity_History].[Created_Date] : SUM(     IF [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] IN ("Pipeline","Best Case", "Most Likely", "Commit")      THEN [Opportunity_History].[Total_Sale_Amount]     ELSE 0     END )})
calcs.label: Open pipeline

calcs.description: Provides the first date from the selected Opportunity Close Date.
calcs.label: First Opportunity Close Date

calcs.description: Based on the selection of the Close Date provides the End Date in a date range.
calcs.label: End Date

calcs.description: Calculates the duration (in days) between valid from and to dates, or from valid to to today if still open.
calcs.expression: (IF DATE([SA_Valid_to_RI_clc]) = DATE(3000-01-01) THEN  DATEDIFF('second',[SA_Valid_to_RI_clc] , DATE(TODAY()))  ELSE DATEDIFF('second',[SA_Valid_From_RI_clc],[SA_Valid_to_RI_clc])  END)/86400
calcs.label: Duration

calcs.expression: IF [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] >= 0 AND [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] < 30 THEN "0-30" ELSEIF [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] >= 30 AND [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] < 60 THEN "30-60" ELSEIF [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] >= 60 AND [Days_Since_last_Activity_clc] < 90 THEN "60-90" ELSE ">90" END
calcs.label: Engagement Buckets

calcs.description: Flags opportunities where the previous close date is earlier than the latest close date.
calcs.expression: IF { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Previous_Close_Date])) } < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Close_Date])) }  THEN 1 ELSE  0 END
calcs.label: Opportunities Pushed

calcs.expression: IF MIN([Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date]) >= DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY())  THEN     IF AVG({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity_Stage],[Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : DATEDIFF('day',MIN([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]),MAX([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) })     > AVG(DATEDIFF('day',[SA_Valid_to_RI_clc], TODAY()))     THEN 0 ELSE 1      END ELSE 0 END
calcs.label: Is Stalled  7 days before

calcs.description: Finds the most recent created date for an opportunity.
calcs.expression: { FIXED DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]):      MAX(         IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]: MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) }         THEN DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])         END     ) }
calcs.label: Created Date

calcs.description: Flags if the opportunity is stalled based on average days in stage.
calcs.expression: IF  AVG({ FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity_Stage],[Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : DATEDIFF('day',MIN([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]),MAX([Previous_Created_Date_RI_clc])) })  > AVG(DATEDIFF('day',[SA_Valid_to_RI_clc], TODAY())) THEN 0 ELSE 1  END
calcs.label: Stalled Opportunities

calcs.description: Lead conversion rate. Calculated as Leads converted / Leads created during the selected period.
calcs.label: Lead Conversion Rate

calcs.description: Age of the lead.
calcs.label: Lead Age

calcs.description: Buckets leads into age ranges based on their lead age, dividing the range into quartiles.
calcs.expression: IF[LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]> { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }    AND [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc] < { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)                      THEN "1. "+STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })) + " - " +( STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4))))  ELSEIF [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]> { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)    AND [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc] < { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 2* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4) THEN  "2. "+STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4))) + " - " + STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } +                      2*(({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4) ))                      ELSEIF [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]> { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 2* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)    AND [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc] < { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + 3* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4) THEN  "3. "+STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + 2* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4))) + " - " + STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 3* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)))  ELSEIF [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]> { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + 3* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)    AND [LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc] < { FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) } + 4* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4) THEN  "4. "+STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 3* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4))) + " - " + STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 4* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)))  ELSE  "5. >"+ STR(INT({ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }+ 4* (({ FIXED : MAX([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) }-{ FIXED : MIN([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]) })/4)))  END
calcs.label: Lead Age Ranges

calcs.expression: ([LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]- (IF [Lead].[Converted_Date] >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) AND  UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'FALSE' THEN DATEDIFF('day',[Lead].[Created_Date],TODAY()) ELSE DATEDIFF('day',[Lead].[Created_Date],[Lead].[Converted_Date]) END))/[LA_Lead_Age_RI_clc]
calcs.label: Lead Age 7 days comparison

calcs.description: Count of Leads.
calcs.label: Lead Count

calcs.description: Provides the last history ID from Opportunity History.
calcs.label: Last History ID

calcs.description: Provides the Last Stage from the Opportunity History.
calcs.label: Last Stage Final

calcs.description: Returns the forecast category for the most recent opportunity history record.
calcs.label: Opportunity Forecast Category

calcs.expression: ([LA_Conversion_Rate_RI_clc]- (IF MIN([Lead].[Converted_Date]) >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) THEN  (COUNT(IF UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted])= 'TRUE'  THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id]  END)/COUNT([Lead].[Lead_Id])) END))/[LA_Conversion_Rate_RI_clc]
calcs.label: Lead Conversion Rate 7 days comparison

calcs.expression: COUNT( IF   UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'TRUE'  THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END ) - COUNT(IF [Lead].[Converted_Date] >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) AND  UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'TRUE' THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END )  /   COUNT(IF   UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'TRUE' THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END)
calcs.label: Lead Converted 7 days comparison

calcs.expression: COUNT( IF   UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'FALSE'  THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END ) - COUNT(IF [Lead].[Converted_Date] >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) AND  UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'FALSE' THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END )  /   COUNT(IF   UPPER([Lead].[Is_Converted]) = 'FALSE' THEN [Lead].[Lead_Id] END)
calcs.label: Lead Open 7 days comparison

calcs.description: Flags open opportunities that have not been modified in over 60 days.
calcs.label: Neglected Opportunities Count

calcs.expression: COUNT([Total_Neglected_Opportunities_RI_clc])- (ZN(COUNTD(     IF [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date] >= DATEADD('day', -7, TODAY())     AND UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed]) = 'FALSE'      AND DATEDIFF('day', [Opportunity].[Last_Modified_Date], TODAY()) > 60     THEN [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Id]     END )))/COUNT([Total_Neglected_Opportunities_RI_clc])
calcs.label: Neglected 7 days comparison

calcs.expression: IF MIN(UPPER([Opportunity].[Is_Closed])) = 'FALSE' AND MAX(DATEDIFF('day',[Opportunity].[Last_Modified_Date],NOW()))>60 THEN SUM([Opportunity].[Total_Amount]) END
calcs.label: Neglected Opportunities Amount

calcs.expression: ([Open_Opportunities_count_clc]-(IF  MIN([Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date]) <= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY())  THEN  COUNTD(IF [Opportunity].[Is_Closed] = 'false' THEN [Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Opportunity] END) END))/[Open_Opportunities_count_clc]
calcs.label: Open Opportunties count 7 days comparison

calcs.description: The total amount of Opportunities that are considered Pipeline and haven't closed yet. Pipeline includes a Forecast category of Pipeline, Best Case, Most Likely, Commit.
calcs.expression: IF [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Forecast_Category1] IN ("Pipeline", "Best Case", "Most Likely", "Commit","Open Pipeline")      THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] END
calcs.label: Open Pipeline

calcs.description: Total Closed Opportunities included Closed Won and Closed Lost
calcs.label: Opportunities Closed

calcs.description: Filters based on the Forecast Category
calcs.label: Opportunity Forecast Category

calcs.description: The history status for the selected period.  Status  may be Current, Previous, or Next.  Calculated for use in another formula.
calcs.expression: IF     CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "current") THEN 0 ELSEIF     CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "previous")  THEN -1 ELSEIF     CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "next")  THEN 1   END
calcs.label: History

calcs.description: Calculates a date by subtracting a time period (year, quarter, month, week, fiscal year/quarter) from the current date, based on a parameter and a value field.
calcs.expression: IF   CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "year")=true THEN DATEADD('year', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY())     ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "fiscal_year")=true THEN  DATEADD('fiscal_year', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "quarter")=true THEN      DATEADD('quarter', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "fiscal_quarter")=true THEN      DATEADD('fiscal_quarter', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "month")=true THEN      DATEADD('month',([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "week")=true THEN      DATEADD('week', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]-1), TODAY())  END
calcs.label: Opportunity History Close Date

calcs.description: Depending on parameter selection, provides the closed date in the format of year, quarter, or month.
calcs.expression: IF   CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "year")=true THEN     DATEADD('year', [Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc], TODAY())       ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "fiscal_year")=true THEN  DATEADD('fiscal_year', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "quarter")=true THEN      DATEADD('quarter', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "fiscal_quarter")=true THEN      DATEADD('fiscal_quarter', ([Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc]), TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "month")=true THEN      DATEADD('month',[Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc], TODAY()) ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm], "week")=true THEN      DATEADD('week', [Opportunity_History_ClosedateValue_RI_clc], TODAY())  END
calcs.label: Opportunity History Close Date

CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm] ,"week")=true THEN     IF DATEPART('week', [Opportunity_History].[Close_Date]) = DATEPART('week', [Opportunity_History_Close_date_Date_part_RI_clc])         AND DATEPART('year', [Opportunity_History].[Close_Date]) = DATEPART('year', [Opportunity_History_Close_date_Date_part_RI_clc])       AND ([SA_Valid_From_RI_clc] > END    ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm] ,"fiscal_year")=true THEN     IF DATEPART('fiscal_year', [Opportunity_History].[Close_Date]) = DATEPART('fiscal_year',      AND ([SA_Valid_From_RI_clc] > [Opportunity_History_Close_date_Date_part_Previous_RI_clc] AND  ([SA_Valid_to_RI_clc] < [Opportunity_History_Close_date_Date_part_RI_clc]))      THEN[Opportunity_History].[Opportunity_History_Id]     END       ELSEIF CONTAINS([Parameters].[SA_Close_Date_RI_prm] , "quarter")=true THEN     IF DATEPART('fiscal_quarter', calcs.expression: IF ISNULL([Average_Deal_Size_Previous_Quarter_clc]) OR  [Average_Deal_Size_Previous_Quarter_clc]= 0 THEN 0 ELSE    AVG([Average_Deal_Size_clc]) - [Average_Deal_Size_Previous_Quarter_clc] / [Average_Deal_Size_Previous_Quarter_clc] END

calcs.description: Win rate. Calculated as the percentage of Won Opportunities vs. the total number of Opportunities.

calcs.description: Returns the forecast category for the previous opportunity history record.
calcs.expression: { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity] : MIN(IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]:      MAX(         IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]: MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) }         THEN DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])         END     ) } THEN  [Opportunity_History].[Forecast_Category] END)}
calcs.label: Previous Forecast Category

calcs.description: Provides the ID from the previous Stage. (Returns the stage name from the previous Opportunity History record.)
calcs.expression: IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) = { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]:      MAX(         IF DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date]) < { FIXED [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity]: MAX(DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])) }         THEN DATETIME([Opportunity_History].[Created_Date])         END     ) } THEN  [Opportunity_History].[Opportunity_Stage] END
calcs.label: Previous Stage Opportunity ID

calcs.expression: IF MIN([Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date]) >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) THEN  COUNTD(IF [IsPushed_RI_clc]>1 THEN [Opportunity].[Opportunity_Id] END) END
calcs.label: Push count 7 days comparision

calcs.expression: (SUM([Pushed_Amount_clc])- IF MIN([Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date]) >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) THEN  SUM(IF [IsPushed_RI_clc]>1 THEN [Opportunity].[Total_Amount] END) END)/SUM([Pushed_Amount_clc])
calcs.label: Pushed Amount 7 days comparision amount

calcs.expression: ([Stalled_Amount_clc]-(IF MIN([Opportunity_Historical_Trend].[Created_Date]) >= DATEADD('day',-7,TODAY()) THEN (IF [Is_Stalled_RI_clc] =1 THEN SUM([Opportunity].[Total_Amount])  END) END))/[Stalled_Amount_clc]
